reason: Expert provides a confirmed troubleshooting rule for traffic counters being at zero despite normal optics and link up, applicable to older transmission devices.

knowledge.summary: On older transmission equipment where the interface is up and optical levels are normal but traffic counters remain at zero, bounce the interface to restore traffic instead of replacing hardware.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Also observed on TRN-042 and TRN-077.
